scope: Single stronger conditional IAP transfer theorem

source.correspondence: IAP predicate definition; source does not state the owner-projection theorem

statement: An onto owner map with finite fibres preserves and reflects IAP on a saturated candidate if each representative has only finitely many ancestry-path disagreements within that candidate.
assumptions: for every a in q^-1(S), finitely many b in q^-1(S) disagree on DescR(a,b) versus DescE(q(a),q(b))
not_claimed: finite edited parent edges imply finite ancestry disagreement
empirical ARG inference satisfies this hypothesis
REF, convexity, connectivity, maximality or specieslike transfer under only these assumptions
novelty or source attribution of this extension
